verses.en: Verily I say unto you my friends, fear not, let your hearts be comforted; yea, rejoice evermore, and in everything give thanks;
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou a’u uo, aua le matatau, ia faamafanafanaina o outou loto; ioe, ia saga olioli pea, ma ia avatu le faafetai i mea uma;

verses.en: Waiting patiently on the Lord, for your prayers have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth, and are recorded with this seal and testament—the Lord hath sworn and decreed that they shall be granted.
verses.sm: Ma faatalitali ma le onosai i le Alii, ona ua ulu atu a outou tatalo i fofoga-faafofoga o le Alii o Sapaota, ma ua tusifaamaumau ma le faamaufaailoga lenei ma le molimau— ua tauto le Alii ma folafola o le a talia i latou.

verses.en: Therefore, he giveth this promise unto you, with an immutable covenant that they shall be fulfilled; and all things wherewith you have been afflicted shall work together for your good, and to my name's glory, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O lea, ua tuuina mai e ia le folafolaga lenei ia te outou, ma se feagaiga e lē masuia o le a faataunuuina i latou; ma o mea uma sa outou puapuagatia ai o le a galulue faatasi mo lo outou lelei, ma le mamalu o lo’u igoa, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you concerning the laws of the land, it is my will that my people should observe to do all things whatsoever I command them.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou e faatatau i tulafono o le laueleele, o lo’u loto, e tatau i lo’u nuu ona vaai ia faia mea uma o soo se mea Ou te poloaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: And that law of the land which is constitutional, supporting that principle of freedom in maintaining rights and privileges, belongs to all mankind, and is justifiable before me.
verses.sm: Ma o lena tulafono o le laueleele ua tusa ma le tulafono faavae, ua lagolagoina le mataupu autu lena o le saolotoga i le faatumauina o aiā ma avanoa, e a tagata uma, ma ua ta’uamiotonuina i o’u luma.

verses.en: Therefore, I, the Lord, justify you, and your brethren of my church, in befriending that law which is the constitutional law of the land;
verses.sm: O lea, o A’u, o le Alii, ua ta’uamiotonuina outou, ma o outou uso o la’u ekalesia, i le lagolagoina o le tulafono lena o le tulafono faavae lea o le laueleele;

verses.en: And as pertaining to law of man, whatsoever is more or less than this, cometh of evil.
verses.sm: Ma e faatatau i tulafono a tagata, soo se mea lava e faapei o lenei, ua sau mai le leaga.

verses.en: I, the Lord God, make you free, therefore ye are free indeed; and the law also maketh you free.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii le Atua, ua faasa’olotoina outou, o lea ua outou saoloto moni ai; ma ua faasa’olotoina foi outou e le tulafono.

verses.en: Nevertheless, when the wicked rule the people mourn.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, a pule e amioleaga e faanoanoa le nuu.

verses.en: Wherefore, honest men and wise men should be sought for diligently, and good men and wise men ye should observe to uphold; otherwise whatsoever is less than these cometh of evil.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e tatau ai ona saili ma le filiga tagata faamaoni, ma o tagata lelei ma tagata atamamai e tatau ona outou vaai ia sapasapaia; a lē o lea, soo se mea e itiiti mai lo ia mea, ua sau mai le leaga.

verses.en: And I give unto you a commandment, that ye shall forsake all evil and cleave unto all good, that ye shall live by every word which proceedeth forth out of the mouth of God.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia outou lafoai i mea leaga uma ma pipii atu i mea lelei uma, ma ia outou ola i afioga uma e tulei mai le fofoga o le Atua.

verses.en: For he will give unto the faithful line upon line, precept upon precept; and I will try you and prove you herewith.
verses.sm: Auā o le a tuu atu e ia i e faamaoni lea fasifuaitau ma lea fasifuaitau, o lea mataupu i lea mataupu; ma o le a Ou faata’ita’ia ma tofotofoina outou i lenei mea.

verses.en: And whoso layeth down his life in my cause, for my name's sake, shall find it again, even life eternal.
verses.sm: Ma ’ai se tasi e tuuina atu lona ola ona o a’u, mo lo’u igoa, o le a toe maua e ia, o le ola lava lea e faavavau.

verses.en: Therefore, be not afraid of your enemies, for I have decreed in my heart, saith the Lord, that I will prove you in all things, whether you will abide in my covenant, even unto death, that you may be found worthy.
verses.sm: O lea, aua le fefefe i o outou fili, auā ua Ou folafola i lo’u loto, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, o le a Ou tofotofoina outou i mea uma, pe tou te tumau ai i la’u feagaiga, e oo lava i le oti, ina ia mafai ona maua e outou le agavaa.

verses.en: For if ye will not abide in my covenant ye are not worthy of me.
verses.sm: Auā afai tou te lē tumau i la’u feagaiga, ua outou lē agavaa mo a’u.

verses.en: Therefore, renounce war and proclaim peace, and seek diligently to turn the hearts of the children to their fathers, and the hearts of the fathers to the children;
verses.sm: O lea, ia tetee ai i taua ma folafola atu le filemu, ma saili ma le filiga e liliu loto o fanau i o latou tamā, ma loto o tamā i fanau;

verses.en: And again, the hearts of the Jews unto the prophets, and the prophets unto the Jews; lest I come and smite the whole earth with a curse, and all flesh be consumed before me.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o loto o tagata Iutaia i perofeta, ma perofeta i tagata Iutaia; ne’i Ou alu atu ma taia le lalolagi atoa i se fetuu, ma mu ai tagata uma i o’u luma.

verses.en: Let not your hearts be troubled; for in my Father's house are many mansions, and I have prepared a place for you; and where my Father and I am, there ye shall be also.
verses.sm: Aua le atuatuvale o outou loto; auā e tele maota o i ai i le fale o lo’u Tamā, ma ua Ou saunia se nofoaga mo outou; ma o le mea e i ai lo’u Tamā ma A’u, o iina foi o le a outou i ai.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, am not well pleased with many who are in the church at Kirtland;
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou lē fiafia tele i le toatele o e o i ai i le ekalesia i Katelani;

verses.en: For they do not forsake their sins, and their wicked ways, the pride of their hearts, and their covetousness, and all their detestable things, and observe the words of wisdom and eternal life which I have given unto them.
verses.sm: Auā ua latou lē lafoaia a latou agasala, ma o latou ala amioleaga, le faamaualuluga o o latou loto, ma lo latou matape’ape’a, ma a latou mea inosia uma, ma tausi i upu o le poto ma le ola e faavavau na Ou tuu atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that I, the Lord, will chasten them and will do whatsoever I list, if they do not repent and observe all things whatsoever I have said unto them.
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a Ou a’oa’iina i latou ma o le a Ou faia soo se mea Ou te loto i ai, pe afai latou te lē salamo ma tausi mea uma o soo se mea na Ou fai atu ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, if ye observe to do whatsoever I command you, I, the Lord, will turn away all wrath and indignation from you, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against you.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, afai tou te vaai ia faia soo se mea Ou te poloaiina ai outou, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a Ou liliu ese le ita ma le toasa uma mai ia te outou, ma o le a lē manumalo faitotoa o seoli ia te outou.

verses.en: Now, I speak unto you concerning your families—if men will smite you, or your families, once, and ye bear it patiently and revile not against them, neither seek revenge, ye shall be rewarded;
verses.sm: O lenei, Ou te tautala atu ia te outou e faatatau i o outou aiga— afai e faa-tasi ona taia o outou, po o o outou aiga, e tagata, ma outou talia ma le onosai ma lē upuleaga faasaga atu ia te i latou, pe saili e tauimasui, o le a tauia outou.

verses.en: But if ye bear it not patiently, it shall be accounted unto you as being meted out as a just measure unto you.
verses.sm: Ae afai tou te lē taliaina ma le onosai, o le a faitauina ia te outou o se mea ua tonu ona fua atu ia te outou.

verses.en: And again, if your enemy shall smite you the second time, and you revile not against your enemy, and bear it patiently, your reward shall be an hundred-fold.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, afai e faa-lua ona taia o outou e lo outou fili, ma outou lē upuleaga faasaga atu i lo outou fili, ma talia ma le onosai, o le a sautua-selau lo outou taui.

verses.en: And again, if he shall smite you the third time, and ye bear it patiently, your reward shall be doubled unto you four-fold;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, afai e faa-tolu ona taia o outou e ia, ma outou talia ma le onosai, o le a faaluaina lo outou taui ia te outou ia sautuafā;

verses.en: And these three testimonies shall stand against your enemy if he repent not, and shall not be blotted out.
verses.sm: Ma o nei molimau e tolu o le a tutu e faasaga i lo outou fili pe afai e lē salamo o ia, ma o le a lē soloiesea lava.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, if that enemy shall escape my vengeance, that he be not brought into judgment before me, then ye shall see to it that ye warn him in my name, that he come no more upon you, neither upon your family, even your children's children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e sao lena fili mai la’u tauimasui, o le a lē aumai ai o ia i le faamasinoga i o’u luma, ona outou vaai ai lea ia outou lapata’ia o ia i lo’u igoa, ia lē toe sau o ia i luga ia te oe, po o luga o lou aiga, e oo lava i fanau a au fanau e oo atu i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa.

verses.en: And then, if he shall come upon you or your children, or your children's children unto the third and fourth generation, I have delivered thine enemy into thine hands;
verses.sm: Ma ona faapea lea, afai e sau o ia i luga ia te oe po o lau fanau, po o le fanau a lau fanau e oo atu i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa, ua Ou tuu atu lou fili i ou lima;

verses.en: And then if thou wilt spare him, thou shalt be rewarded for thy righteousness; and also thy children and thy children's children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.sm: Ma afai e te faasaoina o ia i le taimi lea, o le a tauia oe mo lou amiotonu; ma au fanau foi ma fanau a au fanau e oo i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa.

verses.en: Nevertheless, thine enemy is in thine hands; and if thou rewardest him according to his works thou art justified; if he has sought thy life, and thy life is endangered by him, thine enemy is in thine hands and thou art justified.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ua i ai ou fili i ou lima; ma afai e te tauia o ia e tusa ma ana galuega, ua ta’uamiotonuina oe; afai sa saili e ia lou ola, ma ua lamatia lou ola e ia, ua i ai lou fili i ou lima ma ua ta’uamiotonuina oe.

verses.en: Behold, this is the law I gave unto my servant Nephi, and thy fathers, Joseph, and Jacob, and Isaac, and Abraham, and all mine ancient prophets and apostles.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le tulafono lenei na Ou tuu atu i la’u auauna o Nifae, ma ou tamā, o Iosefa, ma Iakopo, ma Isaako, ma Aperaamo, ma a’u perofeta ma aposetolo uma anamua.

verses.en: And again, this is the law that I gave unto mine ancients, that they should not go out unto battle against any nation, kindred, tongue, or people, save I, the Lord, commanded them.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le tulafono lenei na Ou tuu atu i o’u tagata anamua, e faapea e lē tatau ona latou o atu e tau faasaga i se atunuu, ituaiga, gagana, po o se nuu, vagana ai ua poloaiina ai i latou, e A’u, le Alii.

verses.en: And if any nation, tongue, or people should proclaim war against them, they should first lift a standard of peace unto that people, nation, or tongue;
verses.sm: Ma afai e i ai se atunuu, gagana, po o se nuu e alagaina se taua faasaga mai ia te i latou, e tatau ona muamua o latou sisi atu se tagavai o le filemu i lena nuu, atunuu, po o le gagana;

verses.en: And if that people did not accept the offering of peace, neither the second nor the third time, they should bring these testimonies before the Lord;
verses.sm: Ma afai sa lē talia e lena nuu le ofo o le filemu, po o le taimi lona lua po o le taimi lona tolu, e tatau ona latou aumai na molimau i luma o le Alii;

verses.en: Then I, the Lord, would give unto them a commandment, and justify them in going out to battle against that nation, tongue, or people.
verses.sm: Ona tuu atu ai lea e A’u, o le Alii, se poloaiga ia te i latou, ma ta’uamiotonuina i latou i le o atu e tau faasaga i lena atunuu, gagana, po o le nuu.

verses.en: And I, the Lord, would fight their battles, and their children's battles, and their children's children's, until they had avenged themselves on all their enemies, to the third and fourth generation.
verses.sm: Ma o A’u, o le Alii, e tauina a latou taua, ma taua a a latou fanau, ma fanau a a latou fanau, seia oo ina latou tauimasui mo i latou lava i o latou fili uma, e oo i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa.

verses.en: Behold, this is an ensample unto all people, saith the Lord your God, for justification before me.
verses.sm: Faauta, o se faataitaiga lenei i tagata uma, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua, mo le ta’uamiotonuina i o’u luma.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if after thine enemy has come upon thee the first time, he repent and come unto thee praying thy forgiveness, thou shalt forgive him, and shalt hold it no more as a testimony against thine enemy—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e sau lou fili ia te oe ina ua mavae le taimi muamua, ua salamo o ia ma ua sau ia te oe ma aioi mai mo lau faamagaloga, ia e faamagalo atu ia te ia, ma ia e lē toe taofia o se molimau e faasaga i lou fili—

verses.en: And so on unto the second and third time; and as oft as thine enemy repenteth of the trespass wherewith he has trespassed against thee, thou shalt forgive him, until seventy times seven.
verses.sm: Ma ia faapea lava ona fai e oo atu i le taimi lona lua ma le lona tolu; ma o le tele o taimi e salamo ai lou fili i se agasala na ia faia e faasaga mai ia te oe, ia e faamagalo atu ia te ia, seia faafitugafulu ni fitu.

verses.en: And if he trespass against thee and repent not the first time, nevertheless thou shalt forgive him.
verses.sm: Ma afai e agasala o ia faasaga mai ia te oe i le taimi muamua ma ua lē salamo ai, ae ui i lea ia e faamagalo atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And if he trespass against thee the second time, and repent not, nevertheless thou shalt forgive him.
verses.sm: Ma afai e agasala o ia faasaga mai ia te oe i le taimi lona lua, ma ua lē salamo ai, ae ui i lea ia e faamagalo atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And if he trespass against thee the third time, and repent not, thou shalt also forgive him.
verses.sm: Ma afai e agasala o ia faasaga mai ia te oe i le taimi lona tolu, ma ua lē salamo ai, ia e faamagalo atu foi ia te ia.

verses.en: But if he trespass against thee the fourth time thou shalt not forgive him, but shalt bring these testimonies before the Lord; and they shall not be blotted out until he repent and reward thee four-fold in all things wherewith he has trespassed against thee.
verses.sm: Ae afai e agasala o ia faasaga mai ia te oe i le taimi lona fa, ia e lē faamagalo atu ia te ia, ae ia e aumai na molimau i luma o le Alii; ma o le a lē soloiesea i latou seia salamo o ia ma tauia oe sautuafā i mea uma na agasala ai o ia e faasaga mai ia te oe.

verses.en: And if he do this, thou shalt forgive him with all thine heart; and if he do not this, I, the Lord, will avenge thee of thine enemy an hundred-fold;
verses.sm: Ma afai e faia e ia lenei mea, ia e faamagalo atu ia te ia ma lou loto atoa; ae afai e lē faia e ia lenei mea, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a Ou tauimasui i lou fili mo oe i le sautuaselau;

verses.en: And upon his children, and upon his children's children of all them that hate me, unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.sm: Ma i luga o ana fanau, ma luga o fanau a ana fanau o i latou uma o e e inoino mai ia te a’u, e oo atu i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa.

verses.en: But if the children shall repent, or the children's children, and turn to the Lord their God, with all their hearts and with all their might, mind, and strength, and restore four-fold for all their trespasses wherewith they have trespassed, or wherewith their fathers have trespassed, or their fathers' fathers, then thine indignation shall be turned away;
verses.sm: Ae afai e salamo le fanau, po o le fanau a fanau, ma liliu mai i le Alii lo latou Atua, ma o latou loto atoa, ma o latou manatu atoa, mafaufau atoa, ma le malosi atoa, ma sautuafā ona latou toefuatai atu mo a latou agasala uma na latou agasala ai, po o agasala na faia e o latou tamā, po o tamā o o latou tamā, ona liliu ese ai lea o lou ita;

verses.en: And vengeance shall no more come upon them, saith the Lord thy God, and their trespasses shall never be brought any more as a testimony before the Lord against them. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o le a lē toe oo atu le tauimasui i luga o i latou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lou Atua, ma o le a lē toe aumaia a latou agasala o se molimau i luma o le Alii e faasaga ia te i latou. Amene.
